name: W T K Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，WTK 在种植板块推进多项资产处置：拟以 RM221.50 million 向 Trinity Capital 出售 Positive Deal 65% 股权及两块种植地（约 4,698.20 公顷和 849.60 公顷），并以 RM90.00 million 出售 Biogrow City Plantations 85% 股权及优先股。同时，集团通过收购 Desacorp 和 Imbok Enterprise 股权扩大种植业务，种植产量同比明显上升；木材板块原木产量大幅下降，Tapes 板块则出售槟城工业用地及地上资产。
overview_en: In 2026, WTK pursued several plantation asset disposals: proposed sale of its 65% stake in Positive Deal and two plantation land parcels (approximately 4,698.20 ha and 849.60 ha) to Trinity Capital for RM221.50 million, and proposed sale of 85% equity interest and preference shares in Biogrow City Plantations for RM90.00 million.

segments.name: 种植
segments.note: 今年种植板块一方面通过收购扩大种植公司股权，另一方面推进多项种植资产及子公司股权出售，鲜果串和棕油产量同比上升。
segments.note_en: In 2026 the plantation segment expanded its equity interests in plantation companies through acquisitions while pursuing several disposals of plantation assets and subsidiary stakes;

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Desacorp、Imbok Enterprise 及 WTK Oil Mill 与关联方订立新的经常性关联交易，涉及鲜果串销售与采购、化肥及化学品采购。
actions.text_en: Desacorp, Imbok Enterprise and WTK Oil Mill entered into new recurrent related party transactions involving sales and purchases of fresh fruit bunches and purchases of fertiliser and chemicals.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以 RM221.50 million 向 Trinity Capital Resources 出售 Positive Deal 65% 股权、约 4,698.20 公顷种植地及约 849.60 公顷种植地等种植资产。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal to Trinity Capital Resources of 65% equity interest in Positive Deal and plantation assets including approximately 4,698.20 ha and 849.60 ha of plantation land for a total cash consideration of RM221.50 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以 RM90.00 million 出售 Biogrow City Plantations Sdn Bhd 85% 股权及优先股。
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of 85% equity interest and preference shares in Biogrow City Plantations Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM90.00 million.

actions.title: PART A: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE FOLLOWING:- (I) PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY WTK OF 100.0% EQUITY INTEREST IN DESACORP SDN BH
actions.text: 以及由 Biopalm Venture 收购 Imbok Enterprise Sdn Bhd 70% 股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 100% equity interest in Desacorp Sdn Bhd and, by Biopalm Venture, 70% equity interest in Imbok Enterprise Sdn Bhd.

segments.name: 胶带
segments.note: 今年胶带板块的 Loytape Industries 出售槟城 Seberang Perai Tengah 三块工业租赁地及地上资产。
segments.note_en: In 2026 the Tapes segment's Loytape Industries disposed of three parcels of industrial leasehold land with erected assets in Seberang Perai Tengah, Penang.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Loytape Industries 以 RM38.00 million 现金出售槟城 Seberang Perai Tengah 三块工业租赁地及地上资产。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Loytape Industries disposed of three parcels of industrial leasehold land with erected assets in Seberang Perai Tengah, Penang, for a total cash consideration of RM38.00 million.

segments.name: 木材
segments.note: 今年木材板块原木产量大幅下降，季度产量由上年同期的 18,551 立方米降至 0。
segments.note_en: In 2026 the timber segment's log production fell sharply, with quarterly output dropping to zero from 18,551 cubic metres in the corresponding quarter of the prior year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 季度披露显示，截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度原木产量为 0 立方米，上年同期为 18,551 立方米。
actions.text_en: Quarterly disclosure shows log production of 0 cubic metres for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, compared with 18,551 cubic metres in the corresponding quarter of the prior year.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售 Positive Deal 65% 股权及两块种植地，交易完成后集团将退出相关种植资产。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed disposal of 65% equity interest in Positive Deal and two plantation land parcels; upon completion the group will exit the related plantation assets.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 拟出售 Biogrow City Plantations 85% 股权及优先股。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed disposal of 85% equity interest and preference shares in Biogrow City Plantations;
